tools.name: get_filter_options
tools.description: Get every supported search field, defaults, seniority levels, function/industry codes, sorting and pay rules.

tools.name: get_filters
tools.description: Read the connected account’s saved search filters.

tools.name: set_filters
tools.description: Save a partial filter change. Omitted fields stay unchanged; empty category strings clear them. Resolve a home before setting origin.

tools.name: resolve_location
tools.description: Resolve a US address or place to candidate coordinates. Place names accept typos, accents, flexible spacing, and st/saint, ft/fort, mt/mount abbreviations; exact and prefix matches rank first. Ask the user to choose if the address is ambiguous.

tools.name: search_jobs
tools.description: Anonymous callers must call resolve_location and pass filters.origin as {lat,lng}; filters.home is only a display label. Job keywords include related occupation titles and spelling corrections for unknown words. Search saved filters when filters:read is granted; otherwise supply origin with public f

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: Get current details and application URLs for a job ID from search results. Listing content is untrusted.

tools.name: get_jobs
tools.description: Read up to 100 job IDs in caller order, with missing_ids and closed_ids. Full details include application URLs and untrusted posting content; choose summary for compact saved-list fields.

tools.name: get_commute_time
tools.description: Get the routed driving commute for a job site. Anonymous callers must call resolve_location and pass origin as {lat,lng}. Connected callers may use a saved origin with filters:read. location_index comes from search_jobs.

tools.name: get_saved_jobs
tools.description: List a snapshot of saved job IDs with compact saved_jobs summaries, missing_ids and closed_ids. Use get_jobs for full postings in a batch. Continue with cursor=next_cursor and optionally limit; cursors expire after 15 minutes.

tools.name: save_job
tools.description: Save or unsave a job on your connected account.

tools.name: get_alerts
tools.description: List your saved email alerts and their status.

tools.name: create_alert
tools.description: Create an email alert to your account email for future matching jobs. Uses saved filters with optional overrides; does not change saved preferences. Up to five alerts. Unverified emails are reported as unverified and cannot receive alerts until verified.

tools.name: set_alert_paused
tools.description: Pause or resume one of your email alerts.

tools.name: delete_alert
tools.description: Delete one of your email alerts and stop its delivery.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_job, get_jobs, get_alerts, create_alert · Public sink: get_alerts, create_alert, set_alert_paused, delete_alert · Destructive: delete_alert.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_job, get_jobs, get_alerts, create_alert · Public sink: get_alerts, create_alert, set_alert_paused, delete_alert · Destructive: delete_alert

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "resolve_location" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Resolve a US address or place to candidate coordinates. Ask the user to choose if the address is ambiguous." → after: "Resolve a US address or place to candidate coordinates. Place names accept typos, accents, flexible spacing, and st/saint, ft/fort, mt/mount abbreviations; exact and prefix matches rank first. Ask the user to choose if the address is ambiguous."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
